text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaaah, jeez!! Let's hurry up and go 
home, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Frustrated" doesn't even begin to cover 
it!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Missing out on first place is bad enough, 
but losing to Vodka of all people...?!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I want to get out of here this very 
second!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Come on!! Let's get back as soon as 
possible and start training right away!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Our next Tiara race... the Oaks is right 
around the corner! We don't have time to 
be taking things easy!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah...! I'm definitely not letting you 
have 1st place next time...!!
